title: Neon Veil
short_description: Neon sky dogfighter — thread cyberpunk skylines, lock rockets, grab weapon crates, and hunt outlaws across outlaw sectors.
description: Neon Veil is a neon sky combat flight game for the browser. Dogfight modes: thread cyberpunk skylines, lock heat-seeking rockets, grab weapon crates, and fly portal rings between sectors. Pure neon. Zero voice.
controls_keyboard: WASD fly · Mouse aim · LMB fire · RMB afterburner · F shield · 1-6 weapons · Esc pause · M mute
art_direction: Synthwave neon cockpit dogfighter over a magenta cyberpunk skyline at sunset, cyan HUD, premium browser-game key art.
